title: frontPoolDrawInput
description: The request front-pool-draw.mjs reads via --request or stdin: the timing float a member is asking the pool to front against a bill due before an inflow lands.

feeAvoided.description: Exact HBD decimal string of the fee this draw avoids, or null when unknown.

priceFraction.description: Fraction of the avoided fee the pool prices the draw at; defaults to 1.
